description: Open-source autonomous AI penetration testing. 50 specialist agents across web, API, cloud, Active Directory, Kubernetes, CI/CD and AI/LLM (OWASP LLM Top 10). Runs on a local LLM behind a Privacy Gateway. Integrates with GitHub, GitLab, Jenkins, VS Code, JetBrains, n8n, Grafana & Splunk.
summary: Autonomous AI pentesting engine, continuous offensive security across web, cloud, identity, CI/CD, IaC, databases, Active Directory, Kubernetes and IoT firmware.
